introduction: The Model Variant Support system extends the agent-fox model selection layer to add a `variant` dimension within quality tiers, enabling archetypes and modes to select cost- and latency-efficient model variants (e.g., standard vs. extended context window) without changing the tier abstraction or breaking existing callers.

glossary.0: Ordinal value for the `fast` variant in `VARIANT_ORDER`.
glossary.1: Ordinal value for the `standard` variant in `VARIANT_ORDER`.
glossary.2: Ordinal value for the `extended` variant in `VARIANT_ORDER`.
glossary.ADVANCED: The highest quality tier, containing multiple variants: `claude-opus-4-6` (standard) and `claude-opus-4-6[1m]` (extended).
glossary.None: Python's `None` value, used to indicate no variant dimension or no configured override.
glossary.ArchetypeEntry: A registry data structure in `archetypes.py` defining an archetype's default configuration including model tier and variant.
glossary.ConfigDict: Pydantic v2 configuration class; when set with `extra='ignore'`, unknown keys in TOML or dict inputs are silently dropped.
glossary.EscalationLadder: A class in `escalation.py` that manages tier escalation across a sequence of tiers, preserving variant across escalations.
glossary.MODEL_REGISTRY: The authoritative list of `ModelEntry` objects in `models.py`, mapping model IDs to their tier and variant.
glossary.ModeConfig: A configuration data structure in `archetypes.py` defining per-mode overrides including model tier and variant.
glossary.ModelEntry: A dataclass in `models.py` representing a single registered model with fields for model ID, tier, and optional variant.
glossary.NodeSessionRunner: A class in `session_lifecycle.py` that orchestrates a node's session, responsible for wiring model variant and tier resolution.
glossary.PerArchetypeConfig: A Pydantic model in `config.py` representing config.toml overrides for a named archetype, used at both archetype-level and mode-level.
glossary.SIMPLE: The lowest quality tier, currently mapped to `claude-haiku-4-5`.
glossary.STANDARD: The mid quality tier, currently mapped to `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
glossary.TIER_DEFAULTS: A dict in `models.py` mapping each tier string (SIMPLE, STANDARD, ADVANCED) to the model ID used when no variant is specified.
glossary.VARIANT_ORDER: A dict in `models.py` mapping canonical variant label strings to integer ordinal values for upgrade comparisons: `{"fast": 0, "standard": 1, "extended": 2}`.
glossary.\"extended\": The variant label for a model with an extended context window (e.g., 1M tokens).
glossary.\"fast\": The variant label for a model optimized for speed over context size.
glossary.\"standard\": The variant label for a model's default operational profile (e.g., 200k context).
glossary.\"turbo\": An example of an unrecognized variant string used to illustrate fallback behavior.
glossary._default_pricing_models: The function in `config.py` that returns the list of default model pricing entries.
glossary.archetypes.overrides: The config.toml section `[archetypes.overrides.<name>]` used to override archetype and mode model configuration.
glossary.claude-haiku-4-5: The Anthropic SIMPLE-tier model with no variant dimension (`variant=None`).
glossary.claude-opus-4-6: The Anthropic ADVANCED-tier model with a 200k context window, registered as variant `"standard"`.
glossary.claude-opus-4-6[1m]: The Anthropic ADVANCED-tier model with a 1M context window, registered as variant `"extended"`.
glossary.claude-sonnet-4-6: The Anthropic STANDARD-tier model with no variant dimension (`variant=None`).
glossary.current_variant: The read-only property on `EscalationLadder` that exposes the variant set at construction time.
glossary.default_model_variant: The `ArchetypeEntry` field holding the archetype-level default variant label string.
glossary.legacy dict override: The existing `config.archetypes.models` dict pattern (`archetypes.models.<name> = 'ADVANCED'`) that short-circuits variant resolution at Layer 3.
glossary.model_variant: The field on `ModeConfig` and `PerArchetypeConfig` holding a variant label string override.
glossary.resolve_effective_config: The function that merges archetype-level and mode-level configuration, applying mode-beats-archetype priority for fields like `model_tier` and `model_variant`.
glossary.resolve_model: The function in `models.py` that resolves a tier (and optional variant) to a concrete model ID string.
glossary.resolve_model_tier: The existing function in `sdk_params.py` that resolves the effective tier string for a given archetype/mode context using a 4-layer priority chain.
glossary.cache_creation_price_per_m: USD per million cache-creation input tokens, a rate field in the pricing model.
glossary.cache_read_price_per_m: USD per million cache-read input tokens, a rate field in the pricing model.
glossary.config.archetypes.models: The legacy dict-based override path in config.toml for per-archetype model tier assignments.
glossary.input_price_per_m: USD per million input tokens, a rate field in the pricing model.
glossary.model_id: The string identifier of a registered model (e.g., `claude-opus-4-6`).
glossary.model_id=\"claude-opus-4-6[1m]\": The model ID for the 1M-context ADVANCED variant in the pricing entry.
glossary.model_tier: The model tier string field on config or archetype entries (e.g., `SIMPLE`, `STANDARD`, `ADVANCED`).
glossary.model_variant: The model variant string field on `ModeConfig` and `PerArchetypeConfig`.
glossary.models.py: The source file `packages/agentfox/agentfox/core/models.py` containing model registry and resolution logic.
glossary.output_price_per_m: USD per million output tokens, a rate field in the pricing model.
glossary.resolve_model(): The function in `models.py` that resolves a tier (and optional variant) to a concrete model ID string.
glossary.resolve_model_variant(): The new function in `sdk_params.py` that resolves the effective variant string using a 4-layer priority chain.
glossary.resolve_model_variant: The new function in `sdk_params.py` that resolves the effective variant string for a given archetype/mode context using a 4-layer priority chain.
glossary.starting_variant: The keyword-only constructor parameter on `EscalationLadder` that sets the immutable variant for the lifetime of the ladder.
glossary.tier=ADVANCED: Parameter assignment indicating the ADVANCED quality tier.
glossary.tier=SIMPLE: Parameter assignment indicating the SIMPLE quality tier.
glossary.tier=STANDARD: Parameter assignment indicating the STANDARD quality tier.
glossary.variant: The variant dimension of a model entry — a string label or `None`.
glossary.variant: str | None: Type annotation for the variant field: either a string label or Python None.
glossary.variant=None: Parameter assignment indicating no variant specified (use tier default).
glossary.variant=\"extended\": Parameter assignment indicating the extended context window variant.
glossary.variant=\"standard\": Parameter assignment indicating the standard context window variant.
glossary.variant=: Keyword argument prefix for passing variant to resolve_model().
glossary.model_variant=None: Default value for model_variant field indicating no variant override.
glossary.resolve_model(tier, variant): Calling resolve_model with both tier and variant arguments.
glossary.TIER_DEFAULTS['ADVANCED']: The TIER_DEFAULTS dict entry for the ADVANCED tier.
glossary.variant='standard': Variant field value indicating the standard variant.
glossary.{\"fast\", \"standard\", \"extended\"}: The set of canonical variant label strings.
